title: Arda F Probable NDE 3249
content: I had a outpatient surgery so checked in at 7:00 am and was supposed to be out by 10:00 am. My sister took me to the clinic. Since I was on a Phen-Fen diet prior to my surgery, the doctor could not stop the bleeding as such and I had to go under two other surgeries so they could stop the bleeding. According to my doctor, I had lost about two liters of blood and they could not revive me. All I remember is (I've learned later from my family to be around midnight) I lifted away from physical body and floated to the room (like astronauts), I saw my body on the bed covered in a white blanket. I saw my sister in the room crying; my ex-husband sitting at the bottom in a corner with his hands on the face; my cousin wearing a green jacket standing near the door; about two doctors standing in a corner talking to each other. I went through the wall and entered the hallway where I noticed my brother-in-law (my sister's husband) walking back and forth in the hallway talking to someone on his cell phone. I then floated into a tunnel with all pastel color lights (light pink, peach, and yellow). I knew it was a tunnel as when you looked around, it was round (same as when your drive through a tunnel) and going through the source of the light at the end of the tunnel. There were no one in the tunnel, it was quiet and peaceful but was very, very cold and I started shaking. All I could remember was 'GOD' so I started talking to him telling him 'God, I am so cold, I am so cold, please help.' Then a religious symbol in Islam (Aboulfazr's hand) showed up in the tunnel, it was as big as Empire State building, huge but WARM. I felt the warmth so started going toward the hand to grab it and I did. The minute I touched the hand, I was warmed. I thanked both God and Aboulfazr for helping me. The next thing I know I woke up in the bed at the same room where I left my body. I turned to my left and called a nurse (whom I'd never met or seen in my life) by her first name Kathy who was rubbing my hand. I immediately thanked her for saving my life and told her how I was dead and she brought me back to life. I then asked for my cousin (who is a descendent of Prophet Mohammad) and held his hand which gave me a very special warmth and energy. I then asked to have my brother-in-law to come in and order flowers for Kathy who saved me. I then asked why is my ex-husband asked to come and why one of my friends (NG) was not there. I also said a joke, giggled and collapsed again, where the doctor's took me immediately to an emergency room in a hospital. I was at the hospital for about two weeks and in bed for another month at home to build all the lost blood to be able to even walk again. I know what I experience, None of my families were with me when I went in and were only called to come when there were no hope. I believe the reason for me coming back to life was to take care of my three girls who were about three, four and six at the time. It was very beautiful. I am not scared of dying and I know there is another life after here, only when it is the time to go. I did cross over and came back and it is a beautiful experience.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Uncertain Surgery-related Life threatening event, but not clinical death . I don't understand your question.
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Normal consciousness and alertness As above.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I was very alert during the entire out of body experience and still remember it very well.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Time didn't exist. It felt like a journey without control. Like you are on a train and someone else was driving it. It was just very cold.
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: Interesting you asked this as I don't recall hearing anything.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes I passed through a tunnel with all light pastel colors such as pastel pink, peach, and yellow and when I looked up the top was 'curved' so I knew it was a tunnel and I was floating towards the source of the light.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes Beautiful pastel pink, peach, yellow colors.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Not sure of the question..It was just lights in a tunnel, no other specific...
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes It made it more strong even though I don't practice much. I am very close to God and talk to him constantly.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes It made it more strong even though I don't practice much. I am very close to God and talk to him constantly.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes There are superior powers, God (mystic), religious, whatever you called it/them but is very spiritual. While up there, I was only talking to God.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes We live for the next life. This is a temporary life and how we live in the next life is the result of what kind of human we are in this life.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes 1. It seems I can sense some of the negative things that could happen such as car accidents but not always. Only sometimes.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: When the religious symbol (the hand) appeared with such a warmth where I could hold so won't float away which helped me get back to life.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Immediately as soon as I woke up in bed. They all thought I was hallucinating. Ever since, I've almost told everyone that I have met.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real. It was as real as am writing this. This was not my imagination. I know what I felt. I had no way of knowing who was outside the room or inside the room. I was put to general anesthesia from 7:00 am until 8:00 pm and had no idea. What I saw was exactly what was in the room and outside of the room.
